hero.title: Genshin Impact account tracker
hero.lead: Your Genshin Impact account over time: characters and builds, artifacts, materials, wishes and endgame records, plus a planner for what to farm next.
hero.note: Free. The Teyvat.me Capture app for Windows and Android keeps it up to date.

video.androidLabel: Teyvat.me Capture on Android: start capture, open Genshin, and your account is saved

steps.title: Three steps
steps.connectNote: Updated each time you log in
steps.connectTip: Sign in once in the app; each login then uploads to your tracker.

capture.title: Teyvat.me Capture, the companion app
capture.lead: A free app for Windows and Android that reads your account from the game's network traffic while you play and keeps your tracker up to date. It also saves your account as Leyline JSON, with or without a Teyvat.me account.
capture.readOnlyNote: No game files, no memory, no mods
capture.goodNote: For Genshin Optimizer and any GOOD site
capture.goodTip: Characters, weapons, artifacts, materials, achievements, wishes
capture.firstNote: It can't read a session it didn't see begin
capture.wishFirst: Open the wish history in game first
capture.sendWishesNote: Sends new wishes as they appear

tracker.title: Everything your account holds, over time
tracker.lead: Teyvat.me keeps every capture, so each page shows where your account stands today and how it got there.

characters.title: Characters and builds
characters.text: Every character with level, talents, constellations, weapon and artifacts. Open one for its stats, set bonuses and talent details, and step back through the builds it wore on earlier days.

artifacts.title: Artifacts
artifacts.text: Every artifact with its main stat, substats and rolls, crit value (CV) and roll value (RV), filtered by set, slot or stat, with who wears it.

planner.title: Materials and the planner
planner.text: Your bag, sorted like the game's. Set goals for characters, talents and weapons: the planner works out what each one needs, what to farm today with your resin, and the daily and weekly tasks read from your game.

achievements.title: Achievements and collections
achievements.text: Achievements, Travel Accounts, world quests, the archive and more, ticked from your captures, with hand marks for the rest.

wishes.title: Wish history
wishes.text: Pity, 50/50 wins and every banner you pulled on, synced by the Capture app or imported from paimon.moe, UIGF or a wish link.

endgame.title: Endgame records
endgame.text: Spiral Abyss, Imaginarium Theater and Stygian Onslaught seasons with their enemies, and your own runs and records.

share.title: Share cards
share.text: Build, team, roster, artifact, banner and Stygian cards as PNG images, ready to post.

tracker.sharingNote: With a friend, as viewer or editor

privacy.title: Your data is yours
privacy.exportNote: Leyline format · works with Genshin Optimizer

faq.title: Questions
faq.whatA: A free website that tracks your Genshin Impact account over time: characters, artifacts, materials, achievements, wishes and endgame records, with a planner. Teyvat.me Capture is its separate, free companion app for Windows and Android that keeps it up to date; you can also import Leyline or GOOD files by hand.
faq.freeA: Yes. The tracker and the capture app are both free.
faq.modifyA: No. The app only reads network traffic on your PC or phone. It never touches the game's files or memory and needs no mods.
faq.readsA: What the game sends about your account: characters, weapons, artifacts, materials, achievements and wishes.
faq.adminA: Windows lets only administrators capture network packets.
faq.needA: No. You can import Leyline/GOOD files into the tracker by hand.
faq.serversA: All of them: America, Europe, Asia and TW/HK/MO.
